Public outrage continues to grow following the death of BPJS patient Yurizal Tri Chaerawan, who passed away on July 31, 2026. Before his death, he shared on social media that he had been left waiting for nearly eight hours without any certainty of being assigned a hospital room. His story quickly went viral, raising concerns over the quality and timeliness of medical care.

The controversy intensified after reports emerged that his complaints had been met with dismissive and insensitive responses while he was still alive. Even more disturbing were allegations that some of the mocking and unsympathetic comments circulating online had come from healthcare workers, including nurses and doctors.

Many members of the public have condemned the behavior as a serious violation of medical ethics, arguing that no patient seeking proper healthcare should be treated with ridicule. Calls are now mounting for the relevant authorities and professional bodies to investigate the incident thoroughly and take firm action against anyone found responsible.

Our heartfelt condolences go out to Yurizal Tri Chaerawan's family and loved ones. We sincerely hope that no one else will have to experience a tragedy like this. 💔🥀
